name: ANSI/IEEE early-make normally-open contact symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for early-make normally-open contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The anticipated NO contact form identifies earlier operation relative to documented associated contacts. The common device reference supplies that comparison; the modifier does not assign a universal millisecond operating time.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Compare the linked contacts of the same mechanism.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Relative mechanical sequence differs from an electronic on-delay setting.
